snippet.title: Fearwoods Trailer Pre-Early Access Fotage
snippet.description:
Fearwoods is a cooperative survival horror game where light and silence are your only weapons.

Explore a cursed forest filled with supernatural threats, uncover the mystery behind Aveline’s disappearance, and fight to escape before the darkness consumes you. Work together with up to three players, manage fear, avoid noise, and survive a relentless entity that hunts everything that moves.

🔥 Fearwoods Demo will be featured during Steam Next Fest – February 23 to March 2, 2026.
Wishlist and follow development to stay updated.

🎮 About Fearwoods

Fearwoods is a 1–3 player co-op survival horror experience focused on exploration, teamwork, and psychological tension. Players must collect GPS components to restore navigation systems and escape the forest. While progressing, you can uncover Aveline’s story through journals, clues, and hidden locations — and possibly attempt to save her soul.

Every decision matters.
Every sound can attract danger.
Sometimes survival means staying silent.

👹 Gameplay Features

🔦 Light & sound mechanics – visibility helps survival but attracts the demon
👥 1–3 player co-op survival horror
🌲 Atmospheric cursed forest environment
📖 Story-driven exploration and environmental storytelling
🧩 Puzzle solving and survival mechanics
👹 A relentless supernatural entity that reacts to player behavior
🗺️ GPS collection and escape objective
😈 Multiple story outcomes

📌 Follow Fearwoods

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296990/Fearwoods/ 
👉 Follow development and updates
👉 Join the community for news, gameplay reveals, and upcoming demos
https://discord.gg/7UjDn48ty4
